name: Chris Horowitz Memorial Softcore Championship Trophy
notes: Billed as the prize for this wing's own advertised Softcore Invitational, a six-way elimination match its announcement runs 'in the spirit of the IWF in particular'; the trophy is named, in homage, with the board name of the IWF's own booker, a member of the same community who was still posting on that board into January 2006. No result for that match survives anywhere in the held record.
epitaph: A trophy announced for a match that never got a result, the surest single fact this wing's own record leaves behind.
